instruction: Help me enable fullscreen mode in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling fullscreen mode in GIMP. Evaluator checks sessionrc config for fullscreen = yes. Similar to original UI configuration.
metadata.verified: Uses existing check_config_status metric and get_gimp_config_file getter. Config keys verified against GIMP sessionrc format.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GIMP sessionrc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/sessionrc
Metric correctly parses config file and checks for 'fullscreen yes' key-value pair
Postconfig appropriately quits GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to persist fullscreen setting to sessionrc file
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement (fullscreen mode enabled)
Data flow is semantically correct: enable fullscreen -> quit GIMP -> read persisted config -> verify setting
Minor metadata typo: 'type:' instead of 'type' in expected.rules, but doesn't affect evaluation since metric only uses 'key' and 'value' fields
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional: Fix typo in expected.rules: change 'type:' to 'type' for consistency
Optional: Consider increasing postconfig sleep from 0.5s to 1.0s for slower systems to ensure GIMP fully writes config file
